description: GACM Technologies Limited engaged in the software and financial consultancy related services in India. The company offers software development consultancy and it services, which includes designing, developing, customizing, and maintaining software tools and platforms across industries such as finance, insurance, pharma, education, food and beverages, and legal transcription; and provides IT-enabled services including data processing, database management, and offshore software projects. It also provides trading and financial technology solutions such as commodities trading platforms, order and risk management systems, and infrastructure support for digital trading environments; and enterprise software and cloud applications, deliver end-to-end enterprise solutions for ERP, e-commerce, intranet/internet-based applications, and hosted software. In addition, the company offers hardware and network services; and business process outsourcing, manage outsourced processes such as payroll, CRM, inventory management, accounting and customer support. The company was formerly known as Stampede Capital Limited and changed its name to GACM Technologies Limited in May 2023. GACM Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
